title: ICARE: cross-domain text classification with incremental class-aware representation and distillation learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.24959v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The rise of powerful, fine-tuned large language models (LLMs) necessitates robust natural language inference (NLI) systems. These NLI systems ideally train across various tasks, encompassing diverse concepts like sentiment analysis, news classification, and coreference resolution. However, this continual, multi-tasking approach can lead to catastrophic forgetting, where previously learned tasks are lost, especially in domains lacking specific labels. Rehearsing past examples with labels can further exacerbate this issue by causing overfitting, hindering the system's ability to classify new categories. translated_title: ICARE：基于增量类别感知表示与蒸馏学习的跨域文本分类
translated_abstract: 强大的微调大型语言模型（LLM）的兴起使得稳健的自然语言推理（NLI）系统成为必需。这些NLI系统理想情况下应在各种任务上进行训练，涵盖情感分析、新闻分类和指代消解等多样化概念。然而，这种持续的、多任务的处理方式可能导致灾难性遗忘，即先前学习的任务被丢失，尤其是在缺乏特定标签的领域。使用带标签的过去示例进行重复训练可能因导致过拟合而进一步加剧这一问题，阻碍系统分类新类别的能力。为了应对这些挑战，本研究提出了ICARE，这是一个具有两个关键组件的新颖框架：实例选择模块和知识蒸馏方法。前者基于表示学习，精心选择呈现给NLI系统的训练示例。后者是基于特征和……的知识蒸馏方法（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出ICARE框架，通过基于表示学习的实例选择模块和知识蒸馏方法，解决跨域文本分类中自然语言推理系统的灾难性遗忘与过拟合问题。
en_tdlr: ICARE, a novel framework combining a representation-learning-based instance selection module with knowledge distillation, mitigates catastrophic forgetting and overfitting in cross-domain text classification for natural language inference systems.
